params.name: offer_id
params.description: The offer ID. Used to filter for trades originating from a specific offer.

params.name: base_asset_type
params.description: The type for the base asset. Either `native`, `credit_alphanum4`, or `credit_alphanum12`.

params.name: base_asset_issuer
params.description: The Stellar address of the base asset’s issuer. Required if the `base_asset_type` is not `native`.

params.name: base_asset_code
params.description: The code for the base asset. Required if the `base_asset_type` is not `native`.

params.name: counter_asset_type
params.description: The type for the counter asset. Either native, credit_alphanum4, or credit_alphanum12.

params.name: counter_asset_issuer
params.description: The Stellar address of the counter asset’s issuer. Required if the `counter_asset_type` is not `native`.

params.name: counter_asset_code
params.description: The code for the counter asset. Required if the `counter_asset_type` is not `native`.

params.name: trade_type
params.description: Can be set to all, orderbook, or liquidity_pools to filter only trades executed across a given mechanism.

params.name: cursor
params.description: A number that points to a specific location in a collection of responses and is pulled from the paging_token value of a record.

params.name: order
params.description: A designation of the order in which records should appear. Options include `asc` (ascending) or `desc` (descending). If this argument isn’t set, it defaults to `asc`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of records returned. The limit can range from 1 to 200 - an upper limit that is hardcoded in Horizon for performance reasons. If this argument isn’t designated, it defaults to 10.

items.docs: This endpoint lists all trades and can be used in streaming mode. Streaming mode allows you to listen for new trades as they are added to the Stellar ledger. If called in streaming mode, Horizon will start at the earliest known trade unless a cursor is set, in which case it will start from that cursor.
